# oneprovider_vm (Resource)

OneProvider VM (OneCloud) resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a VM
# Note: location_id, instance_size, and template are IDs returned by the OneProvider API.
# Use the oneprovider_configuration data source to list valid values.
resource "oneprovider_vm" "example" {
  hostname      = "myvm.example.com"
  location_id   = 6
  instance_size = 108
  template      = "909"

  # Optional settings
  enable_ipv6 = false
  ssh_keys    = ["sshkey-uuid-123"]
}

# VM operations (via Update)
resource "oneprovider_vm" "example" {
  # ... existing config ...

  # Trigger VM action (boot, shutdown, reboot, poweroff)
  # Note: This will trigger the action on every apply
  # action = "reboot"

  # Enable rescue mode
  # rescue = true

  # Mount an ISO
  # iso_image = "CentOS-7-x86_64.iso"

  # Unmount ISO (set to empty)
  # iso_image = ""

  # Reinstall with different template (template ID)
  # reinstall_template = "909"
}

# Import existing VM:
# terraform import oneprovider_vm.example 12345
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `action` (String) VM action: boot, shutdown, reboot, poweroff
- `enable_ipv6` (Boolean) Enable IPv6 on the VM
- `hostname` (String) VM hostname
- `instance_size` (Number) Instance size ID for VM creation
- `iso_image` (String) ISO image to mount (use empty string to unmount)
- `location_id` (Number) Location ID for VM creation
- `project_uuid` (String) Project UUID
- `reinstall_template` (String) Template ID to reinstall VM with
- `rescue` (Boolean) Enable rescue mode (true) or disable (false)
- `ssh_keys` (List of String) Array of SSH Key UUIDs
- `template` (String) OS template ID or image UUID for VM creation

### Read-Only

- `cpu` (String) Number of CPUs
- `disk` (String) Disk in GB
- `id` (String) VM ID
- `ip_addr` (String) VM IP address
- `os` (String) Operating system template
- `ram` (String) RAM in MB
- `root_password` (String, Sensitive) Root password (only returned on create)
- `status` (String) VM status
